svg.title: ruflo tui: the console in your terminal
svg.desc: A looping recording of the optional standalone ruflo terminal UI in the console's own looks, with pictures: Classic BBS Overview and Cost, Orbital Overview moving, Swarm graph and Events, then Swarm in a small 80 by 24 window. Sample project and sample agents only.

g.text: Overview, in the Classic BBS look the console starts with
Cost: what each provider spent, from the files on disk
Press t for Orbital: the masthead and globe move
Only the rows that change are redrawn
Swarm: the same graph the console draws
Still readable in an 80 by 24 window
